exposure: SGA status (FGR subgroup vs. SGA percentile 3-10 subgroup)
outcome: Adverse perinatal outcome (APO): arterial cord blood pH ≤ 7.15 and/or 5-minute Apgar ≤ 7 and/or emergency operative delivery and/or admission to the neonatal unit
cohort: 149 singleton pregnancies with suspected SGA (followed-up every 2 weeks) and 143 randomly selected healthy control pregnancies at a university hospital, all starting from 32 weeks gestation
finding: SGA fetuses did not have a higher rate of operative delivery if managed according to a risk stratification protocol.
mod_finding: The number of operative deliveries, especially the cesarean delivery rate after the onset of labor, was similar between SGA fetuses and healthy controls.
